policy.what: March 2024 nationalist online backlash (over remarks on late Wahaha founder Zong Qinghou and son's U.S. passport); Nongfu sales on some e-commerce platforms reportedly fell >90% and market value dropped sharply.
July 2024 Hong Kong Consumer Council bromate/mineral-water classification dispute; council revised rating upward on July 18, 2024.
Nov 2024: Zhong publicly criticized livestream e-commerce and Pinduoduo pricing, calling for government intervention.
2023: Zhong stepped down as legal representative of 12 Nongfu Spring subsidiaries while remaining chairman.
New Hampshire proposed legislation (June 2025 budget) banning property purchases by China and other hostile nations after Nongfu's Nashua deal.
Historic: 2013 water-standards dispute and defamation suit vs Beijing Times; 2020 Wuyi Mountain deforestation allegations (as of 2013/2020).
